name: exp04_h2_hardware
title: H₂ on a noisy IBM processor: readout mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation
description: Trained UCCSD and HEA circuits for H₂ evaluated from shots on a noisy simulator of IBM Fez and on real IBM hardware, raw and with readout mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation. Research question 4.

methods.HEA_L2: 2 layers, best of 5 random starts uniform(-0.1, 0.1)

config.zne_fit: linear least squares over all fold factors, value at 0
config.transpile: optimization_level 1 (keeps the circuit as designed), one fixed pair of physical qubits for every circuit
config.readout_calibration: all 4 basis states, same qubits and shots, full 4x4 assignment matrix inverted
